title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for n(r) must be correctly stated as n(r) = n_0 - r^2/(2dF).

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and state the initial conditions, such as n(0) = n_0.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the derivation leading to the expression for n(r) using the lens formula.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the assumption of thin lens (d << a) and its relevance to the problem.

title: Limit Case Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss the limiting case where F is much greater than r.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the expression for n(r) derived from the lens formula.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all terms in the final expression are dimensionally consistent.
